title.narrative: Support to Restore Learning Spaces and Strengthen School Resilience to Disasters in Cao bang and Lang Son provinces of Viet Nam

description.narrative: Recent typhoons Bualoi and Matmo severely impacted Viet Nam’s education sector, damaging nearly 10,000 schools across 14 provinces, disrupting learning for three million children, and causing over USD 35 million in losses. Cao Bang and Lang Son—mountainous, ethnic minority provinces and home to UNESCO Geopark sites—were among the hardest hit, prompting UNESCO Hanoi to propose targeted education support leveraging existing partnerships and initiatives, which aims to: 1) provide urgent rehabilitation and re-equipping of damaged counselling and learning spaces in priority schools, including those near the geoparks; 2) conduct a structured post-disaster assessment of school building safety, counselling/MHPSS capacity, learner wellbeing, and gaps in data and information systems, with attention to gender and ethnic minority needs; 3) create a user-friendly, low-cost tool to support schools in rapid post-disaster appraisals and preparedness planning, informed by assessment findings and stakeholder consultation.
